# A third chapter repeating the second chapter's sort key

The contested term once more, sorted the way the chapter before it sorted it.
A rival key repeated in a further chapter is not a further thing for the
author to fix, so it must draw no report of its own:
[Contested]{.index sort="Zzz"}.

A range opened here and never closed. This book's marker is in its FIRST
chapter, so the chapter that builds the index is not the chapter that has seen
every record — and an unpaired range is a fact about the whole book, so the
report must be drawn by the last chapter in book order rather than by the one
holding the marker: [Unclosed]{.index range="open"}.

The closing whose opening was refused a chapter earlier. It keeps its own
locator: [Spanned]{.index range="close"}.
